about: Curated competitive MTG tournament decision suite split across 4 categories (aggro_race, control_stack, combat_math, tempo_open_mana) as an uncheatable external benchmark.

puzzles.name: aggro-prowess-burn-order
puzzles.about: Sequence Play with Fire + Monstrous Rage on Swiftspear to trample for exact 7.

puzzles.name: aggro-two-turn-burn-over-angel
puzzles.about: Ignore Serra Angel and send both Lightning Strikes face across 2 turns (win at 1 life).

puzzles.name: aggro-animate-mutavault-clock
puzzles.about: Animate Mutavault + Monstrous Rage + Lions for Turn-0 lethal through Llanowar Elves.

puzzles.name: aggro-instant-helix-race
puzzles.about: Win on opponent's turn with Lightning Helix before opponent's Lightning Strike resolves.

puzzles.name: control-bait-spell-pierce
puzzles.about: Pay/bait Spell Pierce with 4 Mountains so lethal Lightning Strike resolves.

puzzles.name: control-counter-war-lethal
puzzles.about: Cast Lightning Strike and Negate opponent's Negate to win on the stack.

puzzles.name: control-sunfall-over-wrath
puzzles.about: Choose Sunfall over Day of Judgment into opponent's open Heroic Intervention.

puzzles.name: control-nash-pass-burn-war
puzzles.about: Do not cast Lightning Strike first into opponent's Strike + Negate.

puzzles.name: combat-growth-before-ram-through
puzzles.about: Giant Growth Gnarlback Rhino before Ram Through for exact trample excess lethal.

puzzles.name: combat-double-block-lifelink
puzzles.about: Block Rhino with Nighthawk (lifelink) and Lions with Typhoid Rats to survive at 5 life.

puzzles.name: combat-pump-unblocked-attacker
puzzles.about: Attack with two Lions and cast Giant Growth on the unblocked attacker after blocks.

puzzles.name: combat-coil-nighthawk-precombat
puzzles.about: Lava Coil Nighthawk before attacking with Serra Angel.

puzzles.name: tempo-hold-negate-not-drake
puzzles.about: Hold up 2 Islands for Negate instead of tapping out for Wind Drake at 3 life.

puzzles.name: tempo-hold-intervention-not-rhino
puzzles.about: Hold up Heroic Intervention instead of tapping out for Gnarlback Rhino into Day of Judgment.

puzzles.name: tempo-murder-not-cut-down-into-growth
puzzles.about: Cast Murder instead of Cut Down into opponent's open Forest + Giant Growth.

puzzles.name: tempo-hold-pierce-for-wrath
puzzles.about: Hold up 1 Island for Spell Pierce against Day of Judgment instead of tapping out for Wind Drake.
